oracle: This is the opj_compress utility from the OpenJPEG project. (libopenjp2 via jpxref.c, no application colour handling; RelWithDebInfo build, IEEE float: no -ffast-math)
note: Fixtures and references are generated, licence-clean, ours. References are one PGX file per decoded component ('PG ML <+|-> prec w h' then big-endian samples), at the component's own size: subsampled and reduced components are not upsampled.
